scope: Archived noisy-endpoint IV-CFM precursor (sigma_h=0.1), not the final clean-endpoint DualFM recipe
selection: First recorded pair, as in the recent presentation
timeConvention: 0=noise; 1=data. This sampling-progress convention is opposite to the final paper.
comparisonLimits: Same initial X and solver budget. Not identical minibatches or exactly matched parameters/FLOPs. No claim of superior sample quality.
display: Source vertices preserved. Linear interpolation only between saved numerical states. No endpoint modification.
checkerboard: Eight unit cells, origin [ix-2,iy-2], ix/iy 0..3 and (ix+iy)%2==0
loop: Synchronized forward progress; final hold; fade/reset; no reversal
